summary.text: Endless Learning is Fairy Yu Xiu's human path killer move. It creates true meaning in targets so their attainment rises, without consuming the user's or anyone else's attainment level.

claims.text: In Crazed Demon Cave’s eighth layer Green Lotus Dao field, Fairy Yu Xiu sits at the peak of Book Mountain while Divine Emperor City’s learning Gu spreads radiance from her immortal aperture and cooperates with her other Immortal Gu to form Endless Learning. Light-blue radiance covers Gu cultivators on the middle and bottom of the mountain; profundity of the Great Dao flows into them and their attainment levels start to rise. Inside Divine Emperor City’s painting world, Shen Shang and Fang Di Chang see the same learning Gu activate alone, name it the legendary human path Immortal Gu from The Legends of Ren Zu, and treat that solo use as a crack in the city’s intact structure.

Qin Ding Ling treats the rise as proof Heavenly Court was right to develop human path, beyond dream realms alone. The killer move has strategical value for any super force, and it makes use of Fairy Yu Xiu’s attainment level, the secluded domain Book Mountain, and learning Gu. Targets who hit their limit develop illusions and faint, because aptitude, talent, comprehension, and personal experience still bound how much true meaning they can take. The price is still high in thoughts, immortal essence, and Fairy Yu Xiu’s own lifespan. After the first session she rests, then announces another Dao-imparting on Book Mountain three days later and uses Endless Learning again for Gu Masters at the base and Gu Immortals from many small worlds.

Fang Yuan names learning Gu and Endless Learning, and treats the move as the first killer move he has seen, other than dream realms, that can raise attainment levels directly. He has no recollection of it from five hundred years of his previous life, and with Lu Wei Yin’s information he judges it is likely a new creation of Heavenly Court. Lu Wei Yin warns that a unique true-meaning creation method might let Heavenly Court enter Primordial Domain earlier than others, or even obtain Primordial Domain from the ninth layer the way Book Mountain might. Fang Yuan still calls Endless Learning incredible and useful, then points to his own strategic killer move already in play.

In the eighth-layer chaotic battle, Bu Tian Kong charges unhindered after innate luck of Crazed Demon Cave, Endless Learning, and Heavenly Court aid raise its attainment and arm it with Immortal Gu and killer moves. Together with Nie Kuang Feng and Duan Hu, it stands among the strongest Gu Immortals shining on that battlefield.
